fusions.name: Treetop Drop
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles onto the target and pound it for 15 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. For 4 seconds after, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Picked Nits
fusions.desc: Flicks 4 fleas in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 2 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rampart Bound
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Spring-Loaded
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
